summary: Li Bang International Corporation Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, China-based refrigeration equipment maker listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting, adjourned from September 21 to September 22 for lack of quorum under its current memorandum and articles. With 621,418 Class A and 89,008 Class B shares outstanding, holders of 21,122 Class A and all Class B shares constituted a quorum following home-country practice. Shareholders approved an ordinary resolution increasing authorized capital to USD 7,000,000 and a special resolution reducing par value to USD 0.00001. No special situation; routine capital reorganization.
